name: expandable-gallery
blurb: Image gallery where panels expand on hover to fill available space.
description: Renders images in equal-width flex columns. Hovering a panel expands it (3x width) while others shrink. Smooth transition-all animation.
use_when: Image galleries where hover reveals detail without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Mobile or touch-only interfaces. Requires hover to interact.
a11y: Images have src alt attributes. No keyboard alternative to hover expansion.
